app.notes:
Optional sample contents: download a song bank, SoundFonts, background videos, photos, and a songbook, one at a time or all at once, for testing only
Your own folder and downloaded contents now load together
Home shows how many duplicate songs you have, and can remove the extra copies
Search and song lists show each song once, even when it's in your folder twice
Songs named "Number - Artist - Title" now show the right title and artist
With the player buttons hidden in landscape, a small tab on the side pulls the keypad out, and it hides again when a song starts
New Equalizer tab on the karaoke screen, between Play and Practice: a videoke-style equalizer you hear live
The equalizer now shows each band's dB
MIDI and Audio Master Volume can go up to 150%
